newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian funding task unchanged - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian funding task unchanged - Treasury.

text.p: The Australian Treasury said on Wednesday it had no plans to change its previously announced borrowing requirement for 1997/98 (July/June), despite a run up in the budget balance of about A$3 billion snce the May budget.

"At this stage, no revisions have been made to the 1997/98 budget figuring," Tony Hinton, First Assistant Secretary of Treasury's Investment and Debt Division also told an Australian Financial Markets Association dinner.
In the May budget, the government announced an aggregate debt issuance programme of around A$6.5 to A$7.5 billion.
Since then, the preliminary 1996/97 outcome has become available and it showed a run-up in Commonwealth cash balances of about A$3 billion at the end of 1996/97.

However, Hinton siad Treasury had no plans to amend the debt issue programme which was made up of around A$5 to A$6 billion of fixed coupon bond issuance, around A$500 million to A$1 billion index bonds, around A$1 billion of adjustable rate bonds, and, on an end-year basis, no net change in the stock of Treasury notes on issue.
